description: Unit tests for tenantClient utility functions, including methods to normalize tenant IDs, fetch session tenants, select tenants, and manage active tenant storage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant identifier formats to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant data from session API, returning an array of tenants.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and notifies the backend.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the preferred active tenant in local storage.
